scope: Archive-declared sizing from bounded ZIP directory metadata, not installed/peak budget

conditional_accounting_only.scenario: Retain one copy of each downloaded wheel/source archive plus separate runtime and build-tool environments; not installed-space lower/upper bound
unknown_additions: Private Python interpreter and venv/bootstrap files
ANTLR build workspace, produced wheel and runtime installation; source file sum is now known but filesystem/build expansion is not measured
Installer temporary copies/caches unless explicitly bounded later
Generated bytecode, rewritten/generated metadata/scripts, directory and filesystem overhead
Any later separately approved checkpoint/data artifacts
conditional_accounting_only.source_addition_note: Optional one-copy source member-data accounting only; no extraction occurred and tar-stream bytes are a different representation, not another automatic addition

host_capacity_context.meaning: Historical observation only, not current availability or installation permission

method.summary: Each archive: exactly22-byte EOCD and declared central-directory HTTP206 ranges; validate Content-Range/length, cap directory at2000000 bytes, reject nonzero comments/unsupportedZIP64, never fetch/inflate member contents

checks: Correct declared sizes and range positions
